parts.name: Screen
parts.Basic_description: This is the screen part of the display, made primarily of glass with a thin metal or plastic frame.
parts.Functional_description: The screen displays visual output from a computer or other device, serving as the main interface for viewing content.
parts.Movement_description: The screen itself is fixed in position relative to the base, though it may tilt slightly depending on the mount design.

parts.name: Base
parts.Basic_description: This is the base of the display, made of aluminum to provide stability and support.
parts.Functional_description: The base supports the screen and maintains balance, often housing the stand or hinge mechanism.
parts.Movement_description: The base remains stationary on a surface, providing a stable foundation for the display.
